translations.web: Fearing that we would run aground on rocky ground, they let go four anchors from the stern, and wished for daylight.
translations.bsb: Fearing that we would run aground on the rocks, they dropped four anchors from the stern and prayed for daybreak.
translations.kjv: Then fearing lest we should have fallen upon rocks, they cast four anchors out of the stern, and wished for the day.
translations.asv: And fearing lest haply we should be cast ashore on rocky ground, they let go four anchors from the stern, and wished for the day.
